Vintage Lot of 4 Smoking Pipes Missouri Meerschaum Corn Cob Hardwood Wood
This lot includes four vintage smoking pipes: two Missouri Meerschaum corn cob pipes (one with a yellow stem, one with a black stem), a Missouri Meerschaum Hardwood pipe with light brown finish and labeled stem, and a large ornately turned wooden pipe with a brass lid on the bowl. Pipe colors range from natural wood tones to yellow and dark brown. Stems include amber and black plastic. Sizes vary from small to extra-large, with the largest pipe featuring intricate carved details. All pipes show signs of use and wear consistent with age. Suitable for collectors or display.
